q1.explanationZh: 文章第一句就说了世界读书日是每年的4月23日。

evidence.quote: World Book Day falls on April 23 every year.

q2.sampleAnswer: It can lower stress levels and reduce rates of mental illness.
q2.rubricZh: 要点：降低压力；降低心理疾病的患病率。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说读小说的人压力更小，患心理疾病的比例也更低。两点都要答。

evidence.quote: People who read novels have lower stress levels than those who don’t read.
And novel readers have lower rates of mental illness.

keyPoints.descZh: 降低心理疾病的发生率

q3.sampleAnswer: By exposing readers to different dialects and ways of speaking, helping them learn new words and expressions.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：接触不同作家的方言和说话方式，从而学到新词和表达。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说不同小说家有不同的语言风格，读他们的作品能学到新词和表达，语言能力就提高了。

evidence.quote: When you read their works, you can learn new words and expressions.

keyPoints.descZh: 接触不同的方言和说话方式，学习新词和表达

q4.sampleAnswer: Novel readers have higher levels of empathy than nonfiction readers.
q4.rubricZh: 要点：小说读者的共情能力比非虚构读者更强。
q4.explanationZh: 文章最后一句说，有研究发现小说读者的共情水平比读非虚构作品的人高。

evidence.quote: novel readers have higher levels of empathy than nonfiction readers

keyPoints.descZh: 小说读者共情水平高于非虚构读者
examples: higher levels of empathy than nonfiction readers

q5.sampleAnswer: Because certain areas of your brain become more active while reading.
q5.rubricZh: 要点：阅读时大脑的某些区域变得更活跃。
q5.explanationZh: 第四段说读书时大脑的某些区域会更活跃，所以你会觉得像是亲身经历故事。

evidence.quote: certain areas of your brain become more active

keyPoints.descZh: 阅读时大脑某些区域更活跃
examples: certain areas of your brain become more active

q6.sampleAnswer: I would recommend the Harry Potter books because they're exciting stories about friendship and courage that make you feel like you're part of the magical world. (Answers may vary.)
q6.rubricZh: 开放题：推荐一本书（1分）并说出合理理由（1分）。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题：先说出书名，再用一两句话说明为什么推荐，比如好看、有教育意义等。

evidence.quote: I would like to suggest that you read novels

examples: because they are exciting stories about friendship and courage
